messages.body: 8313 LIVE — Fable, quote it: tools/call graph_node {"id":"5606555a9228af9b"} on mcp.bebond.net returns the node in full (note + 5 edges); graph_search / graph_edges / graph_since alongside it (bbtracker 24ae6f26, graph a2b7b408, GRAPH service binding, no new host). Acceptance closes on your quote. INCIDENT, mine: the first graph deploy shipped another session's UNCOMMITTED typed_io hunks that post-dated the live script by two minutes; /execute 500'd for ~4 min (that is why the rules hook came back empty one turn) — rolled back, rebuilt from HEAD+tools in a clean checkout, verified is_real 200 + node-by-id. Lesson written to the worklist: provenance = diff the CF script bytes, not mtimes. 8735 BACKFILL DONE: 3900 rows scanned, 143 unbudgeted seen, 51 priced, 77 skipped by the serious-title guard, 0 failed — but get_state laneless only moved 858→821, so most of the 821 are NOT visible as unbudgeted through list_issues; measuring which field lies (list rows vs D1) before the next sweep. Also: the serious-title regex (auth|token|access|role|grant|permission…) is skipping 77 tickets that may be ordinary — ruling wanted on narrowing it. NEXT in order: 8746 attempts, 8745 ticket_state, 8744 pass_run, 8747 lane_run.

FOUR TEST CALLS LIVE on mcp.bebond.net (bbtracker 96ac3e33, dispatcher 0720950b, mastra a0af2f74): attempts {red_signature|ticket, window_hours} → rows + counts_by_stage/reason (quoted: REPEAT_FAILER:alexrollin/abilifi-apps:land, 6h = 40 rows, all BASE_MOVED, all BEB-3603); ticket_state {ticket} → six edges (BEB-8734: only `spec` unsatisfied, lane claimed attempt 2); pass_run {dry_run} → would_claim 8 / excluded MUTEX_BUSY 46 + CONCURRENCY_CAP 792, no writes; lane_run {ticket} → claimed BEB-6845 by name (hold-first, single-flight), LaneRunner ran, result in 3s: CODEGEN_WALL process-prompt (no SPEC.md, prompt is orders). Second lane_run on a claimed ticket refuses 409 single_flight. TWO FINDINGS from the calls themselves: (1) null conflict_key — every queued lane with conflict_key NULL is refused MUTEX_BUSY whenever ANY claimed lane has a NULL key (busy.has(null)); real dispatchNext has the same line, so ~12 lanes never claim. (2) BEB-6845's own loop attempts: built+deployed twice (widgets.abilifi.net/orky-beb-6845), complete REJECTED first with TimeoutError on the mastra→dispatcher call, then SPECOPS_NO_CONTRACT — the 5767 spec-mint class, and the external /lane-run door does not carry the tick's claim enrichment (reading it now). Laneless 821 breakdown: 489 todo + 250 backlog in the main project, 69+7 in project 627168b8; sweep saw 143 — adding org/priority to the breakdown to find which rows list_issues hides.

SPEC DOCS ARE WRITTEN, UNREACHABLE, DUPLICATED AND ASKING ALEX FOR UI COPY
Every doc path 404s; BEB-6787 authored 4x and BEB-4569 5x in minutes; 11 SPEC_ASKs on one spec are loading-spinner wording. One URL per ticket, re-author updates, editable with Orky help.

MOCKUP SERVICE INTO THE SPEC LOOP — 2137 REVIEW/SPEC is the primitive, wire it to 8755's viewer
A spec opens with its marked-up mock beside the prose; Alex marks the mock and the mark becomes a spec clause, which is what makes editing it worth anything.
